### Headline summary
- Meta and Nvidia released new open-weight models, Muse Spark Open and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, respectively. ([Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/blog/meta-muse-spark-open), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/meta-muse-spark-open/), [Latest stories for ZDNET in Artificial-I](https://www.zdnet.com/innovation/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-model-us-open-weight-ai/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/nvidia-releases-open-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-and-bolt-edge-models/))
- Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion ahead of its IPO while facing regulatory scrutiny from the FTC and eight US states. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/anthropic-reports-16-8-billion-third-quarter-revenue), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/14/ahead-of-ipo-anthropic-reveals-its-revenue-grow-45-sequentially-to-16-8b-in-q3/), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/eight-states-sue-openai-saying-chatgpt-harms-children-2026-10), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261015/p20#a261015p20))
- Amazon launched new AI wearables and Google expanded its Android scam protection features. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/amazons-bee-launches-two-new-personal-ai-devices-starting-at-75/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2287245/bee-frontier-bee-eclipse-bee-pro-launch/), [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-google-ai-scam-detector-apac-singapore/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/10/15/google-adds-enhanced-protection-mode-to-google-messages-and-expands-android-scam-alerts-beyond-pixel/))

### Meta launches Muse Spark Open model
Meta has released the Muse Spark Open AI model, an open-weight release covered by multiple reports. ([Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/blog/meta-muse-spark-open), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/meta-muse-spark-open/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-15/meta-releases-open-ai-model-while-keeping-its-best-tech-closed), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2287833/meta-built-a-huge-open-weight-ai-model-for-macs-but-youll-need-1tb-of-ram-to-run-it/))

### Anthropic reports Q3 revenue ahead of IPO
Anthropic reported third-quarter revenue of $16.8 billion, an increase of nearly 50%, as it prepares for an initial public offering. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/anthropic-reports-16-8-billion-third-quarter-revenue), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/14/ahead-of-ipo-anthropic-reveals-its-revenue-grow-45-sequentially-to-16-8b-in-q3/), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/anthropics-rapid-slowing-growth-weigh-ipo-valuation), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261014/p56#a261014p56))

### US regulators and states investigate OpenAI and Anthropic
Eight US states have sued OpenAI over child safety, while the FTC has subpoenaed both OpenAI and Anthropic for a safety investigation following President Trump's dismissal of AI risks. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/eight-states-sue-openai-saying-chatgpt-harms-children-2026-10), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261015/p20#a261015p20), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/10/15/eight-us-states-sue-openai-alleging-chatgpt-endangered-children-for-profit/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/ftc-subpoenas-openai-anthropic-ai-safety-incidents-trigger-consumer-protection-investigation-3808636))

### Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
Nvidia has launched the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model. ([Latest stories for ZDNET in Artificial-I](https://www.zdnet.com/innovation/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-model-us-open-weight-ai/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/nvidia-releases-open-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-and-bolt-edge-models/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/nvidias-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-is-an-open-model-built-to-run-enterprise-ai-agents-nonstop/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261015/p34#a261015p34))

### Anthropic grants METR access for safety evaluations
Anthropic has granted the safety research organization METR employee-level access to its systems to facilitate independent safety evaluations. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-onboards-six-metr-evaluators-with-employee-like-access/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261015/p41#a261015p41), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-ai-safety-watchdogs-metr-dario-amodei-2026-10), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/anthropic-is-letting-metr-researchers-look-under-the-hood-with-employee-level-access/))

### Amazon launches new Bee AI wearables and subscription
Amazon-owned Bee has launched two new AI devices, the Eclipse and Frontier, which record and analyze audio, alongside a new Pro subscription plan. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/amazons-bee-launches-two-new-personal-ai-devices-starting-at-75/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2287245/bee-frontier-bee-eclipse-bee-pro-launch/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1011475/amazon-bee-frontier-eclipse-price-specs), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-15/amazon-debuts-revamped-bee-ai-wearables-12-a-month-subscription-plan))

### YouTube Music introduces AI-generated song labels
YouTube Music is introducing new labels to identify AI-generated songs. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K3V5FzryA08), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/10/youtube-music-begins-labeling-ai-songs/), [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-youtube-music-ai-generated-song-labels/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2026-10-15/ai-music-deals-are-happening-but-how-artists-will-be-paid-remains-a-mystery))

### Google expands Android scam protection features
Google has added enhanced protection modes to Google Messages, expanded scam alerts beyond Pixel devices, and developed an on-device AI scam detector in partnership with Singapore. ([Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-google-ai-scam-detector-apac-singapore/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/10/15/google-adds-enhanced-protection-mode-to-google-messages-and-expands-android-scam-alerts-beyond-pixel/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-details-circle-to-search-scam-checks-for-android-text-messages/))
